authorization: User delegated rule selection and mining per stock and pattern.
entry: Next complete candle open after first setup or first confirmed breakout in an episode
shorts: Hypothetical price studies; no borrow, derivative basis, funding or availability modeled
selection: Maximize mean net return minus one standard error; require positive train and validation score
test: Final 20% of candles, untouched during selection; embargo one maximum holding period at each boundary
source_adjustment: Use stored OHLC as supplied, reject missing candles and >35% discontinuities; no dividend or corporate action adjustment supplied
